# Salem Place Condominium

> Salem Place is a five-story elevator condominium of 40 one- and two-bedroom homes at 292 Salem Street, Revere, Massachusetts 02151, with private balconies, a first-floor garage and direct access to the Northern Strand rail trail. It is minutes from Route 1, the T, Revere Beach and Boston.

SalemPlaceCondo.com is an independent website. It is not operated or sponsored by the Salem Place Condominium Trust (the condominium association) or its Board of Trustees.

## Pages

- [Home](https://salemplacecondo.com/): the building, amenities, location and the Northern Strand rail trail
- [Units for Rent](https://salemplacecondo.com/rentals): rentals at Salem Place; units are rented by their owners or agents and listed on Apartments.com
- [About](https://salemplacecondo.com/about): how the condominium is organized and governed
- [Contact](https://salemplacecondo.com/contact): send a message through the site

## Key facts

- Address: 292 Salem Street, Revere, MA 02151 (North Revere, Suffolk County)
- 40 condominium homes, 5 stories with elevator
- One- and two-bedroom layouts, about 680 to 1,280 square feet; most are two-bedroom, two-bath
- Every home has a private balcony; many have deeded parking, including garage spaces; guest parking available
- Established in 1987 under Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 183A
